bugs.error_message: A newly saved alias was not available in the shell that launched the TUI.
bugs.root_cause: The TUI runs as a child process and cannot mutate the parent shell; the existing shell had not loaded the new profile wrapper.
bugs.fix: Install a profile-managed alias-manager function that sources the generated alias file after successful exit; reload the profile once in already-running shells.

bugs.error_message: OpenCode sessions keep 'New session - …' placeholder titles; log shows agent=title stream error: AI_APICallError: Bad Request (providerID=venice, modelID=z-ai-glm-5-3-flash).
bugs.root_cause: Venice rejects the title agent's request shape for z-ai-glm-5-3-flash (the small_model); the model works fine for main-agent calls, only the title-agent request fails.
bugs.fix: Set small_model to venice/deepseek-v4-flash in opencode.json. Verified: new sessions get generated titles. Existing placeholder sessions are never re-titled (title gen runs only on a new session's first exchange).
